blockers.detail: No evaluated model, feature group, target variant or ensemble beats the zero-return MAE baseline on any horizon; validation directional accuracy 49-53%. This is a data/signal limitation, not an implementation defect. Next levers: genuine KSE-100 index series, fundamentals/announcements with real publication timestamps, longer histories, intraday data.

PatchTST/N-BEATS/TimesNet/Informer/LSTM/GRU/CNN-LSTM/Transformer-LSTM/TabNet/ARIMA/Prophet/Holt-Winters/GARCH/Kalman/Chronos/Lag-Llama/Moirai were not re-run on the pooled 19-feature cohort (registry dispositions recorded in task100_initial_performance_matrix.json as partial/blocked; 150s command limit + 2 CPUs). Reference LSTM/CNN-LSTM retain their Task 99 OOS evidence.
SVR was in the Task 79 list but is O(n^2)-scale on 32k pooled rows; excluded from the Task 100 bounded cohorts (recorded, not silently omitted).
New simulator tooltips compile (tsc clean) and pages render with zero console errors; the interactive simulator run inside the browser was left to the owner (headless budget).
Empirical quantile coverage and isotonic Brier deltas are within sampling noise on final test; no calibration claim is made.
